raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The duplicate txn_id rows are exact copies in every column, including batch_id and ingest_ts, so they come from a duplicate load in the raw feed rather than distinct transactions. silver_transactions copies them through unchanged, and the gold tables inherit the double counting. Deduplicating the projected columns in silver_transactions removes the duplicates and leaves the gold steps unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT DISTINCT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
